name: Toon Shift
tagline: The world redraws itself as a hand-drawn anime frame.
subject: the person
endFrame: Restyle the entire image as a hand-drawn cel-shaded anime frame: clean ink outlines, flat vibrant colours with soft gradient shading, painterly background, expressive large eyes for {subject}. Same composition, pose and colour palette.
motion: A shimmering wipe sweeps across the frame from left to right. Everything it passes is redrawn as a hand-drawn anime frame with ink outlines and cel shading, the background turning painterly. {subject} blinks and smiles as their hair catches a breeze with stylised anime motion.
sound: a sparkling swoosh and a short upbeat anime-style musical sting
